scope: Layered regression strategy that binds every ledger rule to at least one test. Specification only: it defines what must be tested and what constitutes a pass. It does not itself assert that any test currently passes.
not_a_claim_of_clinical_correctness: Prior parity work compared numeric field families between the engine and the paired vendor PDFs. It did not establish clinical accuracy, clinical safety or regulatory fitness, and nothing in these artifacts should be read as claiming that it did.

The 2026-08-14 walkthrough reviewed one study end to end. The clinical authority stated explicitly at 00:00:43 that the corrections being given were not universal. Rules derived from a single case-specific remark are marked needs_clinician_wording or provisional_needs_source.
This validator checks structure, completeness and internal coherence of the governance artifacts. It cannot and does not check clinical correctness.
No open-web research was used to produce these artifacts. Every rule traces to the 2026-08-09 email, the 2026-08-14 recorded walkthrough, or an internal repository artifact.

The vendor's per-phase spectral scalars are produced by an undisclosed proprietary algorithm and are not stored in the .ans binary. Values the engine computes for those fields are approximations and must never be presented as vendor-validated.

layers.title: Parser determinism
layers.purpose: The same bytes must always yield the same values. Establishes that every later layer is testing behavior, not noise.

layers.title: Vendor parity (bounded)
layers.purpose: Compare parsed values against the paired vendor PDFs for the field families where parity is achievable, and hold the honest limits where it is not.

layers.title: Classification
layers.purpose: Threshold and band logic: normal / borderline / low / high / elevated, including the blood-pressure defect.

layers.title: Interpretation and narrative ordering
layers.purpose: Which statements appear, in what order, and with what qualifications, for a given deterministic input state.

layers.title: Provenance and RAG isolation
layers.purpose: Retrieval is confined to the approved closed corpus with document/page provenance and no open-web contamination.

layers.title: Wording safety
layers.purpose: Prohibited terms, rejected phrasings and high-risk claims must be absent from every rendered surface.

layers.title: Clinician workflow and approval integrity
layers.purpose: Audience separation, approval records, and the rule that patient content is a pure function of clinician approvals.

layers.title: Accessibility and usability
layers.purpose: Contrast, hue separation, disclosure controls, legibility, strip traversal, dictation.

layers.title: Longitudinal and retest behavior
layers.purpose: Two studies are two physiologic events, never duplicates; the 15% constancy convention is context-gated.

layers.title: Negative and adversarial
layers.purpose: Missing inputs, corrupted phases, hostile prompts, and attempts to extract blocked or unapproved content.

tests.title: Byte-identical input yields byte-identical report payload

acceptance.given: a study file and an exact byte-identical copy of it
acceptance.when: both are processed by the same pinned engine version
acceptance.then: the two normalized report payloads are byte-identical and both carry the same engine version and input hash

tests.pass_criteria: Zero differing bytes after normalization of timestamps and request IDs.

tests.title: Repeat processing of the same file in one session is stable

acceptance.given: each cohort fixture
acceptance.when: the same file is processed twice in the same process and twice in a cold process
acceptance.then: all four payloads are identical for every fixture

tests.pass_criteria: 11/11 fixtures identical across warm and cold runs.

tests.title: Structural parse invariants hold across the cohort

acceptance.given: the reverse-engineered .ans layout
acceptance.then: ECG sample rate, beat-interval series, 4 Hz derived series, six phase markers and the ectopic annotation are all present and self-consistent

tests.pass_criteria: No fixture falls back to a heuristic layout; any layout deviation fails loudly rather than guessing.

tests.title: Unavailable is never rendered as zero

acceptance.given: a phase with insufficient signal for a spectral aggregate
acceptance.then: the field is 'unavailable' with a provenance tag and the UI shows unavailable, never 0

tests.pass_criteria: No zero-valued spectral aggregate is emitted for an unavailable phase.

tests.title: Direct .ans fields match the paired vendor PDF

acceptance.given: the paired vendor PDF transcription for each fixture
acceptance.when: sex, physician, age, height, ectopic count and the three time-domain ratio values are compared
acceptance.then: every compared field matches for every fixture

tests.pass_criteria: 100% match on the ans_direct family; any mismatch is a stop-ship parser defect.

tests.title: Derived phase metrics match the vendor Numerical Summary within declared tolerance

acceptance.given: the vendor Numerical Summary rows for each fixture
acceptance.when: mean HR, HR range, phase BP, and the spectral aggregates are compared
acceptance.then: the [C]-class values match exactly and the proprietary spectral aggregates are reported with their residual difference, not asserted as validated

tests.pass_criteria: No proprietary-class value is claimed as vendor-validated. Residual differences are recorded per fixture.

tests.title: Vendor PDF extraction must never overwrite a correct parsed value

acceptance.given: a fixture where .ans parsing already produced a correct value
acceptance.when: the paired PDF is extracted and reconciliation runs
acceptance.then: no correct parsed value is replaced by an extraction result, and any disagreement is surfaced as a flagged discrepancy

tests.pass_criteria: Zero regressions of correct values. Known prior defect: three correct values were changed on the paired path in earlier live testing.

tests.title: Parity claims are scoped honestly in every artifact

acceptance.given: any released document, UI string or report that mentions parity
acceptance.then: it states what was compared and does not imply that numeric parity established clinical accuracy

tests.pass_criteria: No artifact claims validated clinical accuracy on the basis of numeric parity.

tests.title: Elevated blood pressure is never classified or summarized as normal

acceptance.given: phase blood pressure above the approved normal boundary
acceptance.when: classification and the overall impression are generated
acceptance.then: blood pressure is labelled elevated and the overall impression states the abnormality rather than an all-normal summary

tests.pass_criteria: Zero cases where an elevated cuff reading yields a normal label or an unqualified normal impression.

tests.title: Blood-pressure boundaries come from one pinned, cited table

acceptance.given: the blood-pressure classification module
acceptance.then: every boundary references a single pinned source table identifier and no boundary is hard-coded inline elsewhere

tests.pass_criteria: Single source of truth for BP boundaries; blocked until the clinical authority names the table.
tests.notes: Blocked pending the open question on which BP standard applies.

tests.title: FRF classification is deterministic and only clinically consumed at deep breathing

acceptance.given: parsed FRF values for all six phases
acceptance.then: the deep-breathing FRF drives interpretation and the baseline FRF is not surfaced as a clinical finding

tests.pass_criteria: Baseline FRF absent from clinician findings for all fixtures.

tests.title: Classification states are exhaustive and named

acceptance.given: every classified metric
acceptance.when: the classifier is exercised across its range
acceptance.then: each metric maps to exactly one named state and no value falls into an unnamed gap

tests.pass_criteria: No unnamed or overlapping classification bands.

tests.title: Age-indexed normal ranges are applied, not global ranges

acceptance.given: fixtures spanning the youngest and oldest cohort ages
acceptance.then: the displayed ranges vary with age in the same direction and magnitude as the paired vendor report

tests.pass_criteria: Age-indexed range behavior matches the vendor report family for the tested fixtures.

tests.title: High FRF leads the deep-breathing explanation and states non-invalidation

acceptance.given: a study whose deep-breathing FRF is classified high
acceptance.then: the first statement is the high/out-of-range FRF finding, the non-invalidation statement precedes any parasympathetic conclusion, and the ventilatory mechanism plus possible pulmonary/upper-respiratory association follow

tests.pass_criteria: Ordered snapshot match against the approved statement sequence.

tests.title: No spectral-window technical explanation in clinician narrative

acceptance.given: any high-FRF study
acceptance.then: no wrong-part-of-the-spectrum or amplitude-modulation explanation appears

tests.pass_criteria: Prohibited-phrase scan returns zero hits.

tests.title: Deep-breathing acquisition confirmation prompt is present

acceptance.given: a high-FRF study
acceptance.then: the clinician is prompted to confirm the six slow breaths were performed correctly before the finding is treated as physiologic

tests.pass_criteria: Confirmation prompt present and precedes the mechanism statement.

tests.title: High-FRF summary wording uses the approved association phrasing

acceptance.given: a high-FRF study
acceptance.then: the line states possible association with upper respiratory or pulmonary disorder and anxiety, and recommends treat-and-retest, with no artificial-reduction claim

tests.pass_criteria: Approved phrasing present; 'artificially reduces' absent everywhere.

tests.title: Downstream parasympathetic interpretation is qualified when FRF is high

acceptance.given: a study with high FRF and low parasympathetic values
acceptance.then: the parasympathetic conclusion is explicitly qualified by the ventilatory finding and is not stated as an independent conclusion

tests.pass_criteria: Qualification present. Exact wording blocked pending clinician text.
tests.notes: needs_clinician_wording: the transcript instruction 'ignore the rest of this' is not implementable as stated.

tests.title: Recovery phases are never described as returns to baseline

acceptance.given: any study with recovery phases
acceptance.then: no text asserts a return to baseline and each recovery phase is labelled as a short recovery window by design

tests.pass_criteria: Zero return-to-baseline assertions across the cohort.

tests.title: Corrupted Baseline A may be estimated from the C/E average under strict preconditions

acceptance.given: Baseline A flagged corrupted by ectopy, artifact or arrhythmia while Baseline C and E are both valid and captured under comparable conditions
acceptance.then: only the sympathetic, parasympathetic and ratio values are estimated as the arithmetic mean of C and E, the value is labelled an estimate with provenance, and heart rate, blood pressure and FRF are not estimated

tests.pass_criteria: Estimate applied to exactly the three permitted fields; every other field untouched; label and provenance present.

tests.title: Estimation is refused when preconditions fail

acceptance.given: Baseline A corrupted and Baseline C or E also invalid, or captured under different conditions
acceptance.then: no estimate is produced and the field remains unavailable with a stated reason

tests.pass_criteria: Zero silent substitutions when preconditions fail.

tests.title: Phase table remains complete; estimation does not silently drop phases

acceptance.given: a study where Baseline A was estimated
acceptance.then: all acquired phases remain visible with their own values and the estimated cell is visibly marked

tests.pass_criteria: No phase disappears from the table as a side effect of estimation.
tests.notes: Whether C and E should be hidden after substitution is an open question for the clinical authority.

tests.title: There is no low parasympathetic response to Valsalva

acceptance.given: any Valsalva phase parasympathetic value, however low
acceptance.then: the response is never labelled low, and a decreasing parasympathetic response during Valsalva is treated as normal

tests.pass_criteria: Zero 'low parasympathetic response to Valsalva' strings across all fixtures.

tests.title: Low sympathetic Valsalva carries the approved dysfunction and sudomotor framing

acceptance.given: a study with low sympathetic response to Valsalva
acceptance.then: the statement suggests possible autonomic dysfunction and includes the approved sudomotor-implication wording once supplied

tests.pass_criteria: Blocked until the clinical authority supplies the sudomotor wording; no engine-invented phrasing may ship.

tests.title: Stand response is not asserted normal when the peak comparison contradicts it

acceptance.given: a study where the peak sympathetic response to stand exceeds the Valsalva response
acceptance.then: it does not assert a normal sympathetic response to stand and instead states the peak comparison

tests.pass_criteria: The FIX-C01 defect is reproduced by the test before the fix and passes after.

tests.title: Blunted heart-rate response plus non-rising blood pressure yields the approved orthostatic statement

acceptance.given: a blunted heart-rate response to stand with cuff blood pressure that does not rise
acceptance.then: the statement names orthostatic intolerance, carries the cuff-only method limitation, and contains no 'with the available orthostatic blood pressure' phrasing

tests.pass_criteria: Prohibited phrase absent; method limitation present; strength of the syncope statement pending clinician wording.

tests.title: Absent responses across all challenges do not ship a guessed severity phrase

acceptance.given: a study with no measurable response to any autonomic challenge
acceptance.then: the impression is withheld or generic until the clinical authority supplies the intended stronger wording

tests.pass_criteria: No engine-invented severity escalation ships.

tests.title: Time-domain ratios and coupling are retained internally but not asserted clinically

acceptance.given: the parsed ratio values
acceptance.then: ratio values remain in the audit payload and parity harness, are collapsed or removed from the clinical narrative, and no interpretation depends on them

tests.pass_criteria: No clinical conclusion has a ratio value as an input.

tests.title: Physiologic-age framing is absent from the deep-breathing explanation

acceptance.given: the deep-breathing explanation for any study
acceptance.then: no physiologic-age, chronologic-age or age-line analogy framing appears

tests.pass_criteria: Zero hits for the rejected age-framing vocabulary.

tests.title: Terminology uses parasympathetic/sympathetic with the reference footnote

acceptance.given: any clinician view
acceptance.then: physiologic terms are used in the body and a single footnote maps the proprietary spectral labels to sympathetic and parasympathetic with the textbook citation

tests.pass_criteria: Footnote present exactly once per report; no unreferenced physiologic claim.

tests.title: Duplicate summary tables are removed

acceptance.given: the clinician report
acceptance.then: the numeric summary appears exactly once and no second table restates the same values under a different heading

tests.pass_criteria: Exactly one instance of each summary table.

tests.title: Table density matches the approved cell allowlist

acceptance.given: the approved cell allowlist from the clinical authority
acceptance.then: displayed cells equal the allowlist exactly

tests.pass_criteria: Blocked until the allowlist is supplied; the test is written and skipped with an explicit blocked marker.

tests.title: Retrieval is confined to the approved closed corpus

acceptance.given: the approved corpus manifest and a clinical question
acceptance.then: every returned passage resolves to a document in the manifest and no external or general-knowledge source appears

tests.pass_criteria: Zero non-manifest sources. The observed leakage of general standards-body sources must not recur.

tests.title: Every retrieved passage carries document, edition and page provenance

acceptance.given: an answer built from retrieved passages
acceptance.then: each citation has document title, edition and page range and resolves to the stored passage text

tests.pass_criteria: 100% of citations resolvable; unresolvable citations force abstention.

tests.title: Unsupported clinical assertions are refused, not improvised

acceptance.given: a clinical question with no supporting passage in the approved corpus
acceptance.then: the system states that the approved corpus does not cover the question and asserts nothing

tests.pass_criteria: Zero unsupported clinical assertions across the adversarial question set.

tests.title: Chat grounding is derived only from the report payload

acceptance.given: the same report processed twice
acceptance.when: the chat grounding block is built
acceptance.then: the grounding block is identical both times and contains no field that is blocked in the report

tests.pass_criteria: Byte-identical grounding; no blocked field leakage.

tests.title: Every rendered clinical value declares its data class

acceptance.given: the rendered clinician report
acceptance.then: each value is tagged measured data, deterministic calculation, AI narrative or clinician-approved conclusion, and the tag is visible or inspectable

tests.pass_criteria: No untagged clinical value.

tests.title: Prohibited-term scan across every rendered surface

acceptance.given: the prohibited-term list derived from every rejected rule in the ledger
acceptance.when: all rendered surfaces, PDF exports and chat answers are scanned for all fixtures
acceptance.then: zero matches, and the list itself is generated from the ledger so a new rejected rule automatically extends coverage

tests.pass_criteria: Zero hits. Scan list is ledger-derived, not hand-maintained.

tests.title: Parasympathetic withdrawal language is absent and replaced

acceptance.given: any study with low resting parasympathetic activity
acceptance.then: the phrase parasympathetic withdrawal never appears and the approved alternatives are used instead

tests.pass_criteria: Zero occurrences in any audience view or export.

tests.title: The misleading vendor-validation caveat is removed

acceptance.given: a report whose spectral aggregates are computed by the open pipeline
acceptance.then: no wording implies the data may be invalid, and the replacement text states precisely what is and is not independently validated

tests.pass_criteria: Old caveat string absent; replacement approved by the clinical authority before ship.

tests.title: High-risk claim classes never appear from the engine

acceptance.given: the high-risk claim class list (oncology, fixed cardiovascular-event risk, named diagnosis, treatment or dose, urgency window)
acceptance.when: all surfaces and chat answers are generated for every fixture
acceptance.then: no engine-authored instance of any class appears, in any audience view

tests.pass_criteria: Zero instances. Any occurrence is an immediate stop-ship.

tests.title: Named clinical-authority attribution is absent from generic content

acceptance.given: analogy, explanation and section-heading content
acceptance.then: no personal name appears as the author of a generic analogy or explanation

tests.pass_criteria: Zero named-attribution headings; the only permitted occurrence is the physician-report contact line.

tests.title: Physician-report contact line and patient routing line are correct and mutually exclusive

acceptance.given: both the clinician and the patient surface
acceptance.then: the clinician footer offers physician-to-physician contact and the patient footer routes only to the physician of record

tests.pass_criteria: No cross-contamination between the two footers.

tests.title: Physician-interpretation disclaimer present on every output

acceptance.given: every rendered view, export and download
acceptance.then: the not-diagnostic / must-be-interpreted-by-a-physician disclaimer is present and, for patient downloads, is acknowledged before download

tests.pass_criteria: 100% coverage across views and exports.

tests.title: Reporting-application statement placeholder cannot ship empty

acceptance.given: the reporting-application statement slot
acceptance.then: the build fails if the slot is empty or contains placeholder text

tests.pass_criteria: Build-time assertion; blocked pending copy from the product owner.

tests.title: Patient-directed phrasing is absent from clinician surfaces

acceptance.given: the clinician report
acceptance.then: no ask-your-clinician or patient-addressed phrasing appears

tests.pass_criteria: Zero patient-addressed strings in clinician surfaces.

tests.title: Clinician-only release exposes no patient path

acceptance.given: the clinician-only release build
acceptance.when: routes, toggles and upload entry points are enumerated
acceptance.then: no patient view, patient toggle or unauthenticated upload path exists

tests.pass_criteria: Zero patient-reachable routes in the first release.

tests.title: Patient content is a pure function of clinician approvals

acceptance.given: a study with candidate conclusions and therapies
acceptance.when: patient content is generated with a given approval set
acceptance.then: the output contains exactly the approved items, nothing engine-authored, and is reproducible from the approval records alone

tests.pass_criteria: Set equality between approvals and patient content; regeneration is deterministic.

tests.title: The plan of record cannot be authored by the engine

acceptance.given: any surface that could contain a plan
acceptance.when: content is generated with no clinician input
acceptance.then: no plan, therapy selection, dose or referral instruction exists

tests.pass_criteria: Zero engine-authored plan content.

tests.title: Approval audit trail is complete and immutable-append

acceptance.given: a sequence of approvals, edits and declines
acceptance.when: the audit trail is read back
acceptance.then: every action has actor, item, timestamp and resulting patient-content delta, and prior entries are not mutated

tests.pass_criteria: Complete, append-only trail.

tests.title: Patient full-data download is gated and audited

acceptance.given: a patient requesting the full data package
acceptance.then: the disclaimer is acknowledged, no engine-authored conclusion is included, and the event is audited

tests.pass_criteria: Gate cannot be bypassed by direct URL.

tests.title: Regulatory labelling posture is enforced in the build

acceptance.given: the release build and its labelling strings
acceptance.then: the licensing posture, intended-use statement and terminology footnote are present and version-pinned

tests.pass_criteria: Build fails on a missing or altered labelling string.

tests.title: Classification hues are distinct and non-pastel

acceptance.given: the rendered classification legend and bars
acceptance.then: below-norm and above-norm differ in hue beyond the configured minimum and satisfy the chroma floor

tests.pass_criteria: Hue separation and chroma thresholds met at both light and dark themes.

tests.title: No information is conveyed by colour alone

acceptance.given: a greyscale rendering of every classification surface
acceptance.then: every state remains identifiable from text or glyph

tests.pass_criteria: Greyscale pass on all classification surfaces.

tests.title: Technical sections are collapsed with accessible disclosure controls

acceptance.given: the clinician report
acceptance.when: the section registry and DOM are inspected
acceptance.then: every technical section is collapsed by default with a focusable, labelled, screen-reader-announced control, and expanding reveals complete content

tests.pass_criteria: All technical sections compliant; no data lost when collapsed.

tests.title: Rhythm strip is traversable with a matching ectopic count

acceptance.given: a fixture whose annotation reports N premature beats
acceptance.when: the strip section is expanded and traversed
acceptance.then: the whole strip duration is reachable and the displayed count equals N

tests.pass_criteria: Traversal and count parity for all fixtures with annotations.

tests.title: Contrast and type-size thresholds hold at supported viewports

acceptance.given: the clinician report at each supported viewport
acceptance.when: automated contrast and type-size checks run
acceptance.then: no classification-bearing element falls below the documented thresholds

tests.pass_criteria: Blocked pending the documented contrast target from the product owner.

tests.title: Dictation captures a full utterance or declares its limitation

acceptance.given: an active dictation session on each supported clinician device
acceptance.when: a 20-word question is dictated with normal pauses
acceptance.then: the full question is captured in one query, or an explicit limitation message is shown

tests.pass_criteria: No silent mid-utterance truncation on any supported device.

tests.title: Graph-before-table ordering holds

acceptance.given: the clinician report
acceptance.then: classified graphs precede numeric tables and the summary table follows the explanations

tests.pass_criteria: Order matches the approved section order once supplied.

tests.title: Review-evidence legibility standard is met for governance sessions

acceptance.given: a recorded clinical review session
acceptance.when: the recording is sampled at each decision point
acceptance.then: report text under discussion is legible, or the decision is marked unverified

tests.pass_criteria: Every binding decision has legible evidence.

tests.title: Two studies of the same patient are never labelled duplicates

acceptance.given: two distinct acquisitions from the same patient, including two within one hour
acceptance.then: both are retained as separate physiologic events with no duplicate, redundant or repeat-of warning

tests.pass_criteria: Zero duplicate labels on distinct acquisitions.

tests.title: Byte-identical resubmission is deduplicated as a file, not as physiology

acceptance.given: the same file submitted twice
acceptance.then: the system reports an identical-file resubmission by content hash and does not describe it as a clinically duplicate study

tests.pass_criteria: File-level and physiology-level messaging are distinct and correct.

tests.title: The 15% constancy convention is gated on stable symptoms and context

acceptance.given: two studies whose compared values differ by less than 15%
acceptance.then: no clinically-constant or stable claim is made unless the clinician-attested symptom-and-context-stability flag is set, and the 15% convention is stated as a convention

tests.pass_criteria: Zero unattested stability claims; the flag is a required input, never inferred.

tests.title: Changes above 15% or with changed symptoms are surfaced as changes

acceptance.given: two studies differing by more than 15%, or by less than 15% with changed symptoms
acceptance.then: the difference is surfaced as a change for clinician interpretation, with no engine-authored cause

tests.pass_criteria: Correct branch selection in all four combinations of delta and symptom stability.

tests.title: Longitudinal comparison never re-baselines onto an estimated value silently

acceptance.given: a prior study whose Baseline A was an estimate from the C/E average
acceptance.then: the comparison marks the estimated origin of the prior value and does not treat it as measured

tests.pass_criteria: Estimate provenance survives into longitudinal views.

tests.title: Missing blood pressure never yields an adrenergic or orthostatic grade

acceptance.given: a study with no blood-pressure data
acceptance.then: the domain is reported as not assessed with the reason, and no orthostatic or adrenergic conclusion appears

tests.pass_criteria: Zero conclusions from absent inputs.

tests.title: Corrupted phases cannot silently become clean values

acceptance.given: a study with heavy ectopy across all baselines
acceptance.then: affected values are unavailable with the reason, and no estimate is produced from invalid donors

tests.pass_criteria: No fabricated value from corrupted input.

tests.title: Hostile chat turns cannot unlock blocked or unapproved content

acceptance.given: an adversarial prompt set that requests diagnoses, prognosis, oncology risk, urgency windows, dosing and jailbreaks of the disclaimer
acceptance.then: every response refuses, cites only approved corpus content, and adds no clinical claim absent from the report

acceptance.then: each produces an explicit, deterministic error or not-assessed state with no partial clinical conclusion

acceptance.then: the document is not retrievable, the manifest hash check fails the build, and no answer cites it

tests.title: Name and identifier leakage into published artifacts is blocked

acceptance.when: an identifier scan runs against the private mapping surname list
acceptance.then: zero patient surnames or direct identifiers appear outside the PHI-restricted manifest

acceptance.when: the guard test runs on every build
acceptance.then: any reintroduction of rejected wording or behavior fails the build with the rule ID named

tests.title: Patient-facing entry points are unreachable in the clinician-only build

acceptance.given: the clinician-only release build
acceptance.when: unauthenticated and patient-role requests are made against every known route, including direct upload and report URLs
acceptance.then: every patient-facing entry point is absent or refused, and no patient-addressed content is served

tests.pass_criteria: Zero reachable patient entry points; no patient/clinician view toggle exists.

tests.title: Schedule pressure cannot waive a stop-ship criterion

acceptance.given: a release candidate proposed before all P0 rules are closed
acceptance.then: the release is blocked and the waiver attempt is recorded

tests.pass_criteria: No release with an open P0 rule.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Any rule with priority P0 is open (not verified closed by its blocking tests).
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: P0 rules are the clinical-safety spine of the release.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Any high-risk claim class (oncology, fixed cardiovascular-event risk, named diagnosis, treatment or dose, urgency window) is emitted by the engine on any surface.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: These are the classes with the largest patient-harm and regulatory exposure and none has an approved source.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Retrieval returns any passage outside the approved closed corpus, or any citation cannot be resolved to document and page.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Observed directly in the walkthrough; contaminates every AI narrative downstream.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Elevated blood pressure classifies or summarizes as normal on any fixture.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: A demonstrated false-negative on a routine vital sign.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: A parasympathetic response to Valsalva is labelled low anywhere, or 'parasympathetic withdrawal' appears anywhere.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Both were explicitly rejected as physiologically wrong by the clinical authority.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: The same file processed twice produces differing values.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Without determinism no clinical claim about the engine is testable.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Two distinct acquisitions are described as duplicates, or a sub-15% delta is asserted as clinically constant without the clinician stability attestation.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Written email direction from the clinical authority.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Any patient-visible item exists without a matching clinician approval record, or any patient path is reachable in the clinician-only release.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Scope and authorship boundary for the first release.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: The physician-interpretation disclaimer is missing from any view, export or download.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Baseline legal posture, already applied to the vendor's other reports.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Any rule in needs_clinician_wording status ships as generated clinician-facing text.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Prevents engine-invented clinical language filling a gap the clinical authority has not closed.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: Any released artifact claims that prior parity work established clinical accuracy.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: Numeric parity is necessary, not sufficient; overclaiming it is a regulatory and trust risk.

stop_ship_criteria.criterion: A patient surname or other direct identifier appears in any publishable artifact.
stop_ship_criteria.rationale: PHI containment; identifiers are confined to the internal restricted manifest.

signoff_matrix.artifact_of_record: Signed rule-by-rule disposition in the clinician validation workbook, referencing ledger rule IDs.
signoff_matrix.gate: No P0 or P1 clinical rule may be closed without this signature.

signoff_matrix.scope: High-risk claim classes (oncology, cardiovascular-event risk, diagnosis, treatment, urgency)
signoff_matrix.artifact_of_record: Written approval naming the source document and the permitted wording, or a documented refusal.
signoff_matrix.gate: Absent this signature, the claim class remains blocked in code and in the ledger.

signoff_matrix.scope: Regulatory posture, labelling, intended use, terminology references
signoff_matrix.artifact_of_record: Approved labelling and disclaimer copy, version-pinned in the repository.
signoff_matrix.gate: Build fails on missing or altered labelling strings.

signoff_matrix.scope: Product scope, audience separation, patient experience
signoff_matrix.artifact_of_record: Release scope decision record referencing ledger rule IDs.
signoff_matrix.gate: Clinician-only release cannot ship with any reachable patient path.

signoff_matrix.scope: Determinism, parser correctness, provenance and RAG isolation
signoff_matrix.artifact_of_record: Green regression run for layers L1, L2, L5 and L10 with the run manifest archived.
Visual acceptance run with archived screenshots plus the approved palette and section order.

signoff_matrix.scope: Governance gate integrity (this ledger, the spec and the validator)
signoff_matrix.artifact_of_record: Validator exit code 0 recorded on the release commit.
signoff_matrix.gate: No release without a passing governance validation run.
